newsitem.title: FRANCE: Toulouse Jan-Sept air cargo traffic down 13 pct.
newsitem.headline: Toulouse Jan-Sept air cargo traffic down 13 pct.

text.p: Air cargo traffic handled at Toulouse-Blagnac airport in the first nine months of 1996 totalled 18,593 tonnes, a decrease of 13 percent on the same period last year, provisional figures from the airport authority figures showed.
Last month, United Parcel Service, launched a weekday feeder flight between Lyon-Satolas and Toulouse with a two-tonne cargo capacity Beechcraft 1900 chartered from Air Littoral.
DHL Worldwide Express operates a nightly flight between Brussels and Toulouse using a six-tonne capacity Convair aircraft.
Toulouse also features on French express distributor, Jet Services' domestic airfreight network which operates BAe146 (quick change) QC.
Airfreight is also carried by airlines operating passenger services to and from Toulouse.
January-September 1996 postal traffic handled Toulouse Airport increased by three percent on the same period last year to 14,525 tonnes.
French airline, L'Aeropostale, carries overnight mail between its Paris-Charles-de-Gaulle hub and Toulouse using Boeing 737QC aircraft. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
